name: gcc-insurance-fraud-benchmark
description: A dataset for detecting insurance fraud from claims data (textual descriptions and possibly structured metadata). It evaluates models' ability to classify claims as fraudulent or not and to support downstream fraud investigation tasks. The data appears region- or company-specific and is intended for benchmarking automated fraud detection systems.
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited community visibility outside the dataset authors and insurance/ML practitioners.
